definition.en: A long, thin outgrowth of an outer cell near the tip of a root. Root hairs give the root a much larger surface for taking in water and mineral salts.
definition.zh: 根尖附近外层细胞长出的细长突起。根毛让根吸收水和矿物盐的表面大了很多。

definition.en: Tubes that carry water and mineral salts from the roots up through the stem to the leaves, flowers and fruit. Water moves in them only upwards.
definition.zh: 把水和矿物盐从根经过茎向上送到叶、花和果实的管。水在里面只向上走。

definition.en: Tubes that carry sugar made in the leaves to the other parts of the plant, up or down: to the roots, new shoots, flowers and fruit.
definition.zh: 把叶子造的糖向上或向下送到植物其他部分的管：送到根、新芽、花和果实。

definition.en: The scientific name for the water-carrying tubes. Its conducting cells are dead and hollow when they work. Primary pupils are not asked to use this word.
definition.zh: 输水管的科学名称。它的输导细胞工作时已经死去、是中空的。小学不要求使用这个词。

definition.en: The scientific name for the food-carrying tubes, made of living cells joined end to end. Primary pupils are not asked to use this word.
definition.zh: 输食管的科学名称，由首尾相连的活细胞组成。小学不要求使用这个词。

definition.en: How green plants make food: using light energy, they turn water and carbon dioxide into sugar and give out oxygen. It happens in the parts that contain chlorophyll.
definition.zh: 绿色植物制造食物的过程：利用光能，把水和二氧化碳变成糖，并放出氧。它在含有叶绿素的部分进行。

definition.en: The green substance in leaves and other green parts of a plant that takes in light for photosynthesis.
definition.zh: 叶子和植物其他绿色部分里的绿色物质，为光合作用吸收光。

definition.en: The scientific name for the tiny openings in a leaf, each between two guard cells. Carbon dioxide enters and oxygen and water vapour leave through them. Primary pupils may simply say tiny openings.
definition.zh: 叶上小孔的科学名称，每个小孔夹在两个保卫细胞之间。二氧化碳从这里进入，氧和水蒸气从这里出去。小学可以只说「叶上的小孔」。

definition.en: The male part of a flower: a thin filament carrying an anther, which makes pollen.
definition.zh: 花的雄性部分：细细的花丝托着花药，花药产生花粉。

definition.en: The female part of a flower: the stigma that receives pollen, the style, and the ovary that holds the ovules.
definition.zh: 花的雌性部分：接受花粉的柱头、花柱，以及装着胚珠的子房。

definition.en: A small body inside the ovary that contains a female reproductive cell. After fertilisation it becomes a seed.
definition.zh: 子房里的小圆粒，含有雌性生殖细胞。受精以后发育成种子。

definition.en: The moving of pollen from an anther to a stigma, by insects, wind or within the same flower.
definition.zh: 花粉从花药落到柱头上，可以靠昆虫、风，也可以在同一朵花里完成。

definition.en: The joining of a male reproductive cell with a female reproductive cell. In a flower it happens in the ovule, which then becomes a seed, while the ovary becomes the fruit.
definition.zh: 雄性生殖细胞与雌性生殖细胞融合。在花里，受精发生在胚珠中，之后胚珠发育成种子，子房发育成果实。

definition.en: The carrying of seeds away from the parent plant, by wind, water, animals or the fruit splitting open.
definition.zh: 种子离开母株、被带到别处，靠风、水、动物或者果实自己裂开。

definition.en: The start of growth of a seed into a seedling. A seed needs water, air and a suitable temperature to germinate; the root comes out first.
definition.zh: 种子开始长成幼苗。种子萌发需要水、空气和适宜的温度；胚根最先长出来。
